responseMessageContents.text:
Those look great! The illustrated mountain icons have a nice hand-painted/watercolor style with good color variation — each one feels unique and captures the character of different peak shapes. The blue/teal/white palette with subtle warm highlights works well against a dark background, and they'd also pop nicely on a light one.

They're a big step up from generic silhouettes. If you want to use them in the app, you'd just need to export each one individually as a transparent PNG, and I can wire them up to each mountain entry.
